content.text: recurr VVC: first a longer induction, ex, fluconazole 100, 150 or 200 mg every third day for 3 doses (days 1, 4 & 7), then fluconazole 100, 150 or 200 mg wkly for 6 mo = maintenance regimen; uncomp VVC: fluconazole 150 mg PO single dose; severe VVC: 150 mg in two sequential doses (second dose 72 h after the first); preg: ⍉ fluconazole (a single 150 mg dose might be linked to spont abortion & congenital anomalies)

vaginal candidiasis dose 150 mg PO single dose. CI: hypersensitivity to fluconazole or excipients - QT-prolonging CYP3A4 substrates (ex, erythromycin · pimozide · quinidine). Caution in liver dysfun: rare serious hepatotoxicity, incl deaths (mainly in pts w serious underlying dz). Rare QT prolongation & torsades reported; hypokalemia & advanced HF ↑ risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias; ⍉ combine w erythromycin (cardiotoxicity, sudden death). ↑dose (400 to 800 mg/day) first-trimester exposure: case reports of distinct congenital anomalies. Single-dose tablet: more drug-related AEs than intravaginal agents (26% vs 16%)
